ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black medial pixels to high-intensity white distal pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface is dominated by a contiguous low-intensity central mass. High-intensity white pigmentation is localized to the distal 30% of each lobe, featuring high-frequency black dendritic mottling and irregular focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases toward the distal tips, with several larger irregular indentations on the medial-right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex quadratic curve extending from the median notch to the outer tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-intensity clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered across the high-intensity distal zones, likely representing historical colonization points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, unaligned dark linear disruption on the left lobe extending diagonally from the trailing edge toward the center; secondary horizontal linear marks visible on the extreme lateral edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/tissue deficit on the trailing edge of the right lobe, located approximately 40% of the distance from the median notch to the lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique dendritic 'veining' pattern of dark pigmentation on the distal right lobe, contrasting sharply with the white background.
